For videos from yt-dlp sources; anything gallery-dl fetches directly keeps its own format. MKV saves the streams exactly as the site sends them. yt-dlp only — a raw format selector (e.g. \"137+140\", or any of yt-dlp\'s own -f expression syntax) that fully replaces Video quality above for every download. Leave blank to let the quality picker choose as usual.

Overrides quality and output format for all yt-dlp downloads.
Many sites send pictures as WebP, which some apps can\'t open or share. Converts them to JPG as they\'re saved; animated ones stay WebP.

For songs and audio-only downloads. Original saves the site\'s own audio untouched (usually M4A, or Opus). The others convert it unless it\'s already in that format: MP3 plays on anything, FLAC is lossless but can\'t add back quality the source didn\'t have.
Makes every song play at the same loudness, so a quiet track isn\'t followed by a blaring one. Re-encodes the audio.

Looked up on LRCLIB by the song\'s title, artist and length, and saved inside the file. Synced lyrics carry timestamps, so players that support them scroll along with the song; songs without synced lyrics get plain ones.
Also saves synced lyrics as a .lrc file next to the song, for players that only read those.
Extra command-line arguments added to every download. For advanced users.
Automatically switches between Android, iOS, and Web clients if YouTube blocks or slows down a download.
Makes the app look like a real web browser to bypass bot detection on strict websites.
Site-specific yt-dlp tuning (throttling workarounds, player client selection, etc). CLI syntax, e.g. \"youtube:player_client=android,web\". Separate multiple extractors with whitespace.
Raw yt-dlp --format-sort syntax (e.g. \"codec:vp9,fps\"), applied after this app\'s own quality-cap and MP4-compatibility bias so it can still reorder or override them.
Cannot contain quotes, newlines, or shell characters
One \"Header-Name: value\" per line, sent on every yt-dlp download — overrides that header\'s own default (including User-Agent/Referer) rather than only adding new ones.
Logs all internal yt-dlp debug output for advanced troubleshooting.

Without this, Android\'s Battery Saver can silently freeze a download that\'s waiting to start once the app is backgrounded — especially after \"Start now\" is tapped several times in a row. Recommended if downloads seem to get stuck.
